note: USFS San Bernardino NF campground in Jeffrey pine, about 2.5 miles up dirt Forest Rd 3N14 from Fawnskin on Big Bear Lake's north shore; paved inside, with a tight turnaround. The well runs short, so bring water; the nearest dump station is at Serrano Campground. --Claude

flags: CRITERIA (fit, passes): recreation.gov notice 'RV'S over 26 feet not recommended due to limited turn around in campground.' A 23-ft rig is under it; stored 40 ft (driveway lengths) replaced by 26. 35 of the 37 RV-permitted sites take 24 ft or more.

ACCESS (no drop): 'A portion of the road to the campground is rough dirt' (rec.gov) / 'This dirt road will take you approximately 2.5 miles' (FS). No 4WD, high-clearance or 'trailers not recommended' wording.
OHV (flag only, general campground): 'No ATV/OHV in campground'; FS mentions Big Pine Flat OHV staging ~5 miles away and target-shooting areas 2-2.5 miles north on 3N14. Not an OHV campground.

FACILITIES CONFLICT: FS page says 'Restrooms are not available at this site' while rec.gov says 'Vault toilets ... are provided' and 'Flush toilets are not available'; vault_toilets left true. Potable water false from the FS page (rec.gov notice: the well does not produce enough water).
COUNT: rec.gov says 'over 80 single-family sites', some first-come; the catalog lists 67 reservable (37 RV-capable, 30 tent-only). 67 kept.
STATUS: FS page banner 'Site Closed' (out of season; 2026 season ended 10/25). Written open/seasonal.
PHONE 909-382-2790 confirmed (Mountaintop RD / Discovery Center); concessionaire line 909-866-8550.
PIN fine (site centroid ~34.2873,-116.9748 is ~90 m from the stored pin).
